source_request: 이번엔 미소녀가 너무 감소했어. 쿨데레 느낌은 약간 더 살게 된 것 같네. 북해빙궁 느낌은 잘 살린 것 같아. 근데 손에 든 게 검인지 어떤 건지 헷갈리네. 생긴 건 일단 검은 아닌 것 같은데. 소품에 대해서도 지나치게 이상하게 나온 경우 바로잡긴 해야될 것 같아. 물론 중요도 떨어지는 것 까지 집요하게 바로잡아야 하는 건 아니고. 추가로 약간 아쉬운 점이 있다면 이번에는 북해빙궁의 고전적인 느낌이 너무 강해진 것 같다는 느낌이야. 북해빙궁의 비중이 이미지에 너무 표출되면서 미소녀가 미소녀가 아니게 된 것 같은 느낌이지. 이랬다 저랬다 하는 것 같지만 뭐든 균형이 중요한 거 아니겠어? 모든 걸 다 담으려고 하면 미소녀, 쿨데레, 반로환동, 북해빙궁이 각각 넘치려고 하면서 균형이 깨지기 마련이라 프롬프트 컨셉을 잡을 때나 작성할 때나 중요한 포인트를 정확히 표현하는 게 좋다고 생각해. 이 점들을 고려해서 독립된 서브에이전트 환경에서 다시 한번 개선하여 프롬프트를 작성하고 이미지를 다시 생성해줘.
interpreted_intent: A balanced contemporary wuxia beauty campaign whose first read is an unmistakably adult beautiful young woman, whose second read is cool reserve with a tiny equal-peer response, and whose rejuvenated authority, ice-palace setting, and single sword remain quiet supporting evidence.
subject: An unmistakably adult woman in her mid-twenties with the attached portrait's facial appearance, restored beauty prominence, loose modern swordmaster hair, and restrained adult elegance.
setting: A restrained modern Northern Sea Ice Palace pavilion built from clear ice planes and thin silver seams, with clean negative space rather than an ornate historical tableau.
event: After equal-rank sparring, an adult peer settles a charcoal mantle across her shoulders; she silently secures it and lets only her lower eyelids soften toward his withdrawing hand.
visual_priorities: The first glance is a luminous adult beauty portrait with the face large and dominant.
The second read is cool reserve plus one small selective acceptance of an equal adult peer.
Youthful adult appearance carries quiet centuries-old authority through one seal and effortless frost.
A modern minimalist ice pavilion and one readable straight sword remain supporting evidence.
Major hand and prop geometry stays simple and clear while minor decorative quirks are not composition priorities.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a contemporary luxury wuxia beauty editorial of an unmistakably adult woman in her mid-twenties, strikingly beautiful and softly charming. Use the portrait only for facial casting: pale skin, tapered oval face, adult-scale gray eyes, slim nose, full rose lips, nose-side beauty mark, and ash-blonde loose half-up hair. Frame a vertical waist-up three-quarter portrait; face large and dominant, gaze oblique toward the adult companion's partial profile and hand at the right edge. An ancient ice-sect master restored to a youthful adult form, she carries centuries of authority through one weathered belt seal and effortless frost. In a restrained modern Northern Sea Ice Palace of clear ice planes and thin silver seams, her same-ranked adult sparring partner has just placed a charcoal training mantle across her shoulders. She maintains a cool unreadable mouth and composed posture. His clearly adult hand withdraws from the mantle edge. She closes two fingers around the cloth, and only her lower eyelids soften toward his departing hand. He pauses in visible surprise while the mantle remains secured. Matching plain black training bracers identify equal peers. Her fingers hold only cloth while his release it; both hands stay simple and separate. One plain straight double-edged jian stands vertically in a wall rack, with wrapped grip, small straight guard, and continuous steel blade clearly readable and separate from every hand. Keep the palace and sword as quiet supporting evidence. Use an 85mm beauty lens, shallow depth, soft pearl key light, cool rim light, tailored ivory and ice-blue couture, realistic adult skin, and a contemporary fashion-campaign finish.
